name: Personal leave, unpaid (事假)
authority: Interim Wage Payment Regulation (劳部发〔1994〕489号) arts.11–12 list the paid absences; personal leave outside them is unpaid, deducted at the monthly wage ÷ 21.75 a day (人社部发〔2025〕2号).

name: Annual leave (带薪年休假)
authority: 职工带薪年休假条例 (State Council Order 514, from 1 January 2008, https://xzfg.moj.gov.cn/front/law/detail?LawID=208) art.2: a worker in continuous work for more than twelve months is entitled; art.3: cumulative service 1–10 years 5 days, 10–20 years 10, 20 or more 15 (statutory holidays and rest days inside it not counted); art.5: unused days paid at 300% of the day wage. 企业职工带薪年休假实施办法 (MOHRSS Order 1, from 18 September 2008, https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/trlzyhshbzbgz_17256/20200617/t0035_1388390.html) art.3: the twelve months may be with this or earlier employers; art.4: service with every employer counts toward the ladder (`employment.prior_service_months`); art.5: a new hire’s year is the calendar days left with this employer ÷ 365 × the full days, the part day dropped; art.12: a leaver’s year is (calendar days with this employer this year ÷ 365) × the full days less days taken, the part day dropped, no clawback of excess. Not modelled: the art.4 disqualifications (long paid personal or sick leave), a leap year read as 366 by CALENDAR_DAYS rather than the measure’s 365, and deemed service (register CN-N05, CN-N18).

name: Maternity leave (产假及生育假)
authority: 女职工劳动保护特别规定 (State Council Order 619, from 28 April 2012, https://xzfg.moj.gov.cn/mobile/law/detail?LawID=343) art.7: 98 days of maternity leave, up to 15 before the birth; 15 more for a difficult birth and 15 more for each additional infant; a miscarriage under four months of pregnancy 15 days, at four months or more 42 days. 云南省人口与计划生育条例 (third amendment 17 January 2022, http://ynswsjkw.yn.gov.cn/html/2022/faguiguizhangxin_0121/11292.html) art.18, with art.35 (every leave in the regulation is calendar days; working days inside it are paid): a lawful birth extends the maternity leave by 60 days of 生育假. Each infant beyond the second adds another 15 days, counted as the recorded children born on the event date (`children.multiple_born_on(event.date)`); a multiple birth with fewer than two recorded is refused. The Kunming maternity allowance (register CN-KM32) is outside this row.

name: Paternity leave (护理假)
authority: 云南省人口与计划生育条例 (third amendment 17 January 2022, http://ynswsjkw.yn.gov.cn/html/2022/faguiguizhangxin_0121/11292.html) art.18, with art.35 (every leave in the regulation is calendar days; working days inside it are paid): the father of a lawful birth has 30 days of 护理假.

name: Marriage leave (婚假)
authority: 国劳总薪字〔1980〕29号: one to three paid days of marriage leave at the unit’s discretion (register CN-N51); 云南省人口与计划生育条例 (third amendment 17 January 2022, http://ynswsjkw.yn.gov.cn/html/2022/faguiguizhangxin_0121/11292.html) art.18, with art.35 (every leave in the regulation is calendar days; working days inside it are paid): staff of every unit type who register a marriage have 15 more days. The seed grants the national three (the discretionary maximum) plus fifteen: 18 calendar days.

name: Childcare leave (育儿假)
authority: 云南省人口与计划生育条例 (third amendment 17 January 2022; controlling text http://ynswsjkw.yn.gov.cn/html/2022/faguiguizhangxin_0121/11292.html, unreachable 28 Sep 2026 — clause read on the Yunnan Department of Justice copy https://sft.yn.gov.cn/yfzs/pages_1_3173.aspx): a parent of a lawfully born or adopted child under three has 10 days of 育儿假 a year from their unit, 15 where two or more children are under three; art.35 counts the leave as attendance at normal pay. The year is the calendar year and the days do not carry over; they end when the child turns three (楚雄市卫生健康局 guidance, 18 Sep 2023, https://www.cxs.gov.cn/info/9025/254978.htm). Each parent holds the days separately; whether the other parent’s leave is taken is not a condition. The lawful-birth test is the operator’s record (register CN-KM12).
